   184→    def _parse_time_input(
   185→        self,
   186→        time: Union[float, dtm.timedelta, dtm.datetime, dtm.time, None],
   187→        shift_day: bool = False,
   188→    ) -> Optional[dtm.datetime]:
   189→        if time is None:
   190→            return None
   191→        if isinstance(time, (int, float)):
   192→            return self._tz_now() + dtm.timedelta(seconds=time)
   193→        if isinstance(time, dtm.timedelta):
   194→            return self._tz_now() + time
   195→        if isinstance(time, dtm.time):
   196→            date_time = dtm.datetime.combine(
   197→                dtm.datetime.now(tz=time.tzinfo or self.scheduler.timezone).date(), time
   198→            )
   199→            if date_time.tzinfo is None:
   200→                # dtm.combine uses the tzinfo of `time`, which might be None, so we still have
   201→                # to localize it
   202→                date_time = localize(date_time, self.scheduler.timezone)
   203→            if shift_day and date_time <= dtm.datetime.now(UTC):
   204→                date_time += dtm.timedelta(days=1)
   205→            return date_time
   206→        return time

   251→        user_id: Optional[int] = None,
   252→        job_kwargs: Optional[JSONDict] = None,

   255→
   256→        Args:
   257→            callback (:term:`coroutine function`): The callback function that should be executed by
   258→                the new job. Callback signature::
   259→
   260→                    async def callback(context: CallbackContext)
   261→
   262→            when (:obj:`int` | :obj:`float` | :obj:`datetime.timedelta` |                         \
   263→                  :obj:`datetime.datetime` | :obj:`datetime.time`):
   264→                Time in or at which the job should run. This parameter will be interpreted
   265→                depending on its type.
   266→
   267→                * :obj:`int` or :obj:`float` will be interpreted as "seconds from now" in which the
   268→                  job should run.
   269→                * :obj:`datetime.timedelta` will be interpreted as "time from now" in which the
   270→                  job should run.
   271→                * :obj:`datetime.datetime` will be interpreted as a specific date and time at
   272→                  which the job should run. If the timezone (:attr:`datetime.datetime.tzinfo`) is
   273→                  :obj:`None`, the default timezone of the bot will be used, which is UTC unless
   274→                  :attr:`telegram.ext.Defaults.tzinfo` is used.
   275→                * :obj:`datetime.time` will be interpreted as a specific time of day at which the
   276→                  job should run. This could be either today or, if the time has already passed,
   277→                  tomorrow. If the timezone (:attr:`datetime.time.tzinfo`) is :obj:`None`, the
   278→                  default timezone of the bot will be used, which is UTC unless
   279→                  :attr:`telegram.ext.Defaults.tzinfo` is used.
   280→
   281→            chat_id (:obj:`int`, optional): Chat id of the chat associated with this job. If
   282→                passed, the corresponding :attr:`~telegram.ext.CallbackContext.chat_data` will
   283→                be available in the callback.
   284→

   286→
   287→            user_id (:obj:`int`, optional): User id of the user associated with this job. If
   288→                passed, the corresponding :attr:`~telegram.ext.CallbackContext.user_data` will
   289→                be available in the callback.

   291→                .. versionadded:: 20.0
   292→            data (:obj:`object`, optional): Additional data needed for the callback function.
   293→                Can be accessed through :attr:`Job.data` in the callback. Defaults to
   294→                :obj:`None`.

   317→            name=name,
   318→            trigger="date",
   319→            run_date=date_time,
   320→            args=(self, job),
   321→            timezone=date_time.tzinfo or self.scheduler.timezone,
   322→            **job_kwargs,
